comment: Brotli -q 11 bytes of each program's wasm, as CI measures them (ubuntu, the latest Go 1.25.x); a local build with another Go patch release can differ by a percent or two. CI fails when a program grows more than `tolerance` over its record, or links a package on its deny list. A change that grows a program on purpose raises its record in the same diff; one that shrinks it lowers the record. See docs/perf/README.md. `maxCode` caps a package's code bytes, for a package linked only for its init: hello may link encoding/json's init (hooks and h import it) but none of its functions (#126).
